title: Conversation and Speaking Expressions — Level 8 — Arrange and transform

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a correct request: "you / me / Would / mind / helping / ?"

visual.text: Would you mind helping me?

choices.say: Would you mind helping me?

visual.text: Would me mind helping you?

choices.say: Would me mind helping you?

visual.text: Would you helping mind me?

choices.say: Would you helping mind me?

visual.text: Would mind you helping me?

choices.say: Would mind you helping me?

items.reteach: Pola: Would you mind + V-ing + object?

items.prompt: Change into reported speech: Raka said, "Let's go to Ijen tonight."

visual.text: Raka suggested going to Ijen that night.

choices.say: Raka suggested going to Ijen that night.

visual.text: Raka suggested to went to Ijen tonight.

choices.say: Raka suggested to went to Ijen tonight.

visual.text: Raka said let's going to Ijen.

choices.say: Raka said let's going to Ijen.

visual.text: Raka suggested went to Ijen that night.

choices.say: Raka suggested went to Ijen that night.

items.reteach: "Let's …" dilaporkan dengan "suggested + V-ing"; tonight → that night.

items.prompt: Change into reported speech: The teacher said to us, "Please open your books."

visual.text: The teacher asked us to open our books.

choices.say: The teacher asked us to open our books.

visual.text: The teacher asked us open our books.

choices.say: The teacher asked us open our books.

visual.text: The teacher asked us opening your books.

choices.say: The teacher asked us opening your books.

visual.text: The teacher asked to us open our books.

choices.say: The teacher asked to us open our books.

items.reteach: Permintaan dilaporkan: asked + object + to + V1; your → our.

items.prompt: Which sentence is the most polite way to say "Close the window."?

visual.text: Could you close the window, please?

choices.say: Could you close the window, please?

visual.text: You close the window.

choices.say: You close the window.

visual.text: Close the window now!

choices.say: Close the window now!

visual.text: Must you close the window?

choices.say: Must you close the window?

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "on / Congratulations / your / achievement / great"

visual.text: Congratulations on your great achievement.

choices.say: Congratulations on your great achievement.

visual.text: Congratulations your great on achievement.

choices.say: Congratulations your great on achievement.

visual.text: Congratulations great on your achievement.

choices.say: Congratulations great on your achievement.

visual.text: Congratulations on great your achievement.

choices.say: Congratulations on great your achievement.

items.reteach: Pola: Congratulations on + your + adjective + noun.

items.prompt: Which sentence has the same meaning as "Why don't we take the bus?"

visual.text: Let's take the bus.

choices.say: Let's take the bus.

visual.text: We didn't take the bus.

choices.say: We didn't take the bus.

visual.text: Why did we take the bus?

choices.say: Why did we take the bus?

visual.text: We must not take the bus.

choices.say: We must not take the bus.

items.prompt: Change into reported speech: Ayu asked me, "May I use your laptop?"

visual.text: Ayu asked if she could use my laptop.

choices.say: Ayu asked if she could use my laptop.

visual.text: Ayu asked could she use my laptop.

choices.say: Ayu asked could she use my laptop.

visual.text: Ayu asked if may she use my laptop.

choices.say: Ayu asked if may she use my laptop.

visual.text: Ayu asked that she can use your laptop.

choices.say: Ayu asked that she can use your laptop.

items.reteach: Pertanyaan yes/no dilaporkan dengan if + subject + verb; may → could; your → my.

items.prompt: Put the dialogue in the best order. (P) Could you help me with this maths question? (Q) Sure. What's the problem? (R) I can't find the area of this triangle. (S) Just multiply the base by the height, then divide by two.

visual.text: P – Q – R – S

choices.say: P – Q – R – S

visual.text: Q – P – R – S

choices.say: Q – P – R – S

visual.text: P – R – Q – S

choices.say: P – R – Q – S

visual.text: R – P – S – Q

choices.say: R – P – S – Q

items.reteach: Minta tolong → bersedia → jelaskan masalah → beri petunjuk.

items.prompt: Make a question that asks for an opinion about the film.

visual.text: What do you think of the film?

choices.say: What do you think of the film?

visual.text: What do you think the film?

choices.say: What do you think the film?

visual.text: What do you thinking of the film?

choices.say: What do you thinking of the film?

visual.text: What are you think of the film?

choices.say: What are you think of the film?

items.reteach: Pola: What do you think of/about + noun?

items.prompt: Change into reported speech: The doctor said to me, "You should drink more water."

visual.text: The doctor advised me to drink more water.

choices.say: The doctor advised me to drink more water.

visual.text: The doctor advised me drink more water.

choices.say: The doctor advised me drink more water.

visual.text: The doctor advised me drinking more water.

choices.say: The doctor advised me drinking more water.

visual.text: The doctor advised to me drink more water.

choices.say: The doctor advised to me drink more water.

items.reteach: Nasihat dilaporkan: advised + object + to + V1.

items.prompt: Arrange the words: "I / to / sorry / hear / am / that"

visual.text: I am sorry to hear that.

choices.say: I am sorry to hear that.

visual.text: I am to hear sorry that.

choices.say: I am to hear sorry that.

visual.text: I am sorry that to hear.

choices.say: I am sorry that to hear.

visual.text: I sorry am to hear that.

choices.say: I sorry am to hear that.

items.reteach: Ungkapan simpati: I am sorry to hear that.

items.prompt: Combine into one polite refusal: "I want to come. I have to babysit my little brother."

visual.text: I'd love to come, but I have to babysit my little brother.

choices.say: I'd love to come, but I have to babysit my little brother.

visual.text: I'd love to come, so I have to babysit my little brother.

choices.say: I'd love to come, so I have to babysit my little brother.

visual.text: I'd love coming, and I have to babysit my little brother.

choices.say: I'd love coming, and I have to babysit my little brother.

visual.text: I'd love to come, because I babysit my little brother.

choices.say: I'd love to come, because I babysit my little brother.

items.reteach: Menolak sopan: I'd love to + V1, but + alasan.

items.prompt: Change into reported speech: Dimas said to me, "Would you like to come to my house?"

visual.text: Dimas invited me to come to his house.

choices.say: Dimas invited me to come to his house.

visual.text: Dimas invited me coming to his house.

choices.say: Dimas invited me coming to his house.

visual.text: Dimas invited me to came to his house.

choices.say: Dimas invited me to came to his house.

visual.text: Dimas invited to me come to my house.

choices.say: Dimas invited to me come to my house.

items.reteach: Undangan dilaporkan: invited + object + to + V1; my → his.

items.prompt: Arrange the words into a telephone request: "speak / I / to / Could / Mr. Hadi / please"

visual.text: Could I speak to Mr. Hadi, please?

choices.say: Could I speak to Mr. Hadi, please?

visual.text: Could speak I to Mr. Hadi, please?

choices.say: Could speak I to Mr. Hadi, please?

visual.text: Could I to speak Mr. Hadi, please?

choices.say: Could I to speak Mr. Hadi, please?

visual.text: I could speak to Mr. Hadi, please?

choices.say: I could speak to Mr. Hadi, please?
